en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.225 - Abdullah ibn Sinan asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)

about a man who becomes junub (ritually impure) during a cold night and fears for his life if he performs ghusl (ritual bathing).
Imam (as) said: 'He should perform tayammum and pray, and when he is safe from the cold, he should perform ghusl and repeat the prayer.'
